applies_to: string literals of O/core/**/*.py, docstrings excluded (design §18.1 T1-1); also O/tests/core/** (T5-1). Case-insensitive.
not_tokens_note: analysis names alone and the Resolution keys of design §8.3 are core vocabulary; each regex below is checked to give 0 hits on these words standing alone

tokens.form: dot directive at start of a line (or of the literal)
internal device/model vector  @<kind>.<path>[<param>]  or its prefix '@m.'
control-script command at start of a line, with argument form
control-script command inside one-line joined script (after ';' or within .control text)
simulator option names other than core Resolution keys

open_points: D9 also bans the simulator name in core literals; if the core must log the adapter name it reads it from the adapter, not a literal
D4 may hit Korean/English prose like 'v(x)' inside non-docstring message literals; T1-1 counts them as dialect (intended)
PDK names (T1-2) are a separate list taken from descriptors/engine decl, not here
